comment: The Biryani was exceptionally well prepared, steaming hot, and perfectly spiced. Extremely excited about the food quality here! Table service was prompt and polite.
Extremely frustrated! We waited for 45 minutes to get our food. When it arrived, the fries were cold and tasteless. Unclean tables as well.
Disappointed with my visit. I found a hair in my salad! Also, the staff behavior was rather cold when I raised the concern. Waiting time was also too long.
Very nice ambience, great music volume, and clean tables. The pricing is a bit high but the staff behavior was friendly. Will return.
Overall experience was average. The waiting time was fine, but the menu options were limited. Taste was ok, nothing special.
Absolutely happy with the quick service! We reserved table 4 and the reservation experience was flawless. Food was delicious and price was fair.
Warning: I had a severe allergy reaction to the peanuts in the sauce. I specifically mentioned the allergen to the staff but they neglected it. Unacceptable!
Angry about the delay. We had a reservation at 8 PM but were seated only by 8:30 PM. Hostess was frustrated and unhelpful.
